answer: With a Phone SIM bound by callback verification with revocation on transfer, the account is only as strong as its binding: the phone sim answers a fresh challenge, the callback verification is recorded, and revocation on transfer keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so losing the channel means losing the identity, and fakes cannot hide behind throwaway channels. One willow proves nothing on its own; the proof is in the whole pattern of bindings. The spiral marks the start and the sparrow the end, yet the claim is checked again at both points.
